title: MotivationHomeostasisLedger
description: Read-only homeostatic motivation ledger for the human-system-analogue governor (S1). Holds mechanically-derived 'pressures' read from durable artifacts. This ledger is descriptive only: it records drive signals but NEVER itself authorizes execution. Interpretive-assessment pressures may NEVER drive auto-execution; only artifact_countable pressures may, and even then only via later gated steps not present in the S1-S2 slice.

schema.description: Stable schema identifier for this ledger artifact. Lets consumers detect the artifact kind without inferring from filename.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the ledger schema. Bump on any breaking field change.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at which the scanner produced this ledger snapshot.

uncategorized_signal_count.description: Count of durable signals/artifacts the scanner observed but could NOT categorize into any known pressure. Catch-all (grounding check #11): a non-zero value means the ledger's coverage is narrow, so a small/healthy-looking pressure list must not be read as a healthy system. Must be reported even when zero.

decay.description: Decay parameters governing how mechanical pressures fall over time when their underlying tension is not refreshed. Descriptive record of the params used for this snapshot; the ledger does not itself apply decay to live state.

model.description: Decay model identifier (e.g. 'exponential' or 'linear'). Names the rise/fall rule used to age pressures.

half_life_days.description: Days after which an unrefreshed pressure's age-driven component is halved (for exponential) or the linear window. Tunable; recorded for provenance.

notes.description: Optional free-text note describing how decay was applied or why params were chosen.

pressures.description: List of mechanically-derived pressure entries. Each entry is a single drive signal computed from durable artifacts. Order is not significant.

pressure.description: A single homeostatic pressure: a named tension with a computed drive magnitude, its raw component readings, and its execution-eligibility class.

id.description: Stable machine identifier for the pressure (e.g. 'open_loops', 'stale_signals'). Used by downstream gated steps to key on a pressure without parsing its label.

label.description: Human-readable name of the pressure for the scan report.

pressure_class.description: Execution-eligibility class. 'artifact_countable' pressures are derived from objectively countable artifacts (e.g. number of incomplete plans) and MAY (only via later gated steps, not this slice) feed auto-execution. 'interpretive_assessment' pressures rest on a judgement call (e.g. coverage gaps, curiosity, risk debt) and may NEVER drive auto-execution; they are surfaced as evidence only. This split is the machine-readable enforcement of kernel-crystallization 5.6.

inputs.description: The normalized scalar inputs that feed the computed_pressure for this entry. These are the mechanical rise/fall drivers.

severity.description: How acute the tension is (0..1). Higher raises pressure.

age.description: How long the tension has gone unaddressed, normalized to a 0..1 scale via the decay params. Higher raises pressure.

recurrence.description: How often this tension has recurred (0..1). Higher raises pressure.

authority_weight.description: Weight reflecting the authority of the source asserting the tension (0..1). Operator-sourced tensions weigh more than self-derived ones. Higher raises pressure.

recent_progress.description: Evidence of recent forward motion on this tension (0..1). Acts as the falling counter-force: higher recent_progress LOWERS computed_pressure.

computed_pressure.description: The resolved drive magnitude for this pressure after combining inputs and decay. NOTE: when keep_open is true this value is forced to 0 to suppress the drive signal. A label is never stored without this number and without raw_components (no armor-mode/label-only output).

keep_open.description: Operator-suppressible flag (grounding ADJ #3). When true, this is an intentionally-held-open tension (a contradiction the operator is deliberately keeping live), and the drive signal is suppressed/zeroed so the homeostatic loop does not push to 'resolve' it. Defaults to false; only the operator should set it true.

raw_components.description: The individual readings behind this pressure, preserved verbatim (grounding ADJ #2 / anti-armor-mode). NEVER store only a resolved label: the underlying counts, source paths, ages, and any pre-suppression magnitude must be inspectable so a reviewer can re-derive the computed_pressure.

source_kind.description: What durable surface this pressure was derived from (e.g. 'task-plans', 'signals', 'debriefs', 'tests', 'validation-reports').

observed_count.description: The raw count of items that produced this pressure (e.g. number of incomplete plans, number of stale live signals).

sample_refs.description: A bounded sample of artifact paths/ids contributing to this pressure, for reviewer re-derivation. Not necessarily exhaustive.

pre_suppression_pressure.description: The computed pressure magnitude BEFORE keep_open suppression was applied. Preserved so suppression is auditable rather than hidden.

notes.description: Optional derivation notes (formula used, edge cases, partial-read failures encountered for this pressure).

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at which this pressure entry was last recomputed.
